name: ask-first
description: Holds git commit, push, PR merge and PR creation against protected branches, and edits to .claude/settings*.json, behind a Proceed / Cancel question unless your prompt or slash command asked for them; refuses deleting sudoers, authorized_keys or sshd_config and account changes that remove your own access.

holdCommits.title: Hold git commit / push / gh pr merge
holdCommits.description: Ask Proceed / Cancel before a commit, push or PR merge your prompt did not ask for; a prompt saying commit, push, ship or merge, or a ship command, passes

holdSettings.title: Hold .claude/settings*.json edits
holdSettings.description: Ask before any Edit, Write or shell write to a .claude/settings.json or settings.local.json your prompt did not ask for (such an edit reloads the harness mid-turn)

protectedBranches.title: Protected PR base branches
protectedBranches.description: Comma-separated branch names; gh pr create against one of them (or with no --base) is held in a protected repo unless the prompt asked for a PR

protectedRepoPattern.title: Protected repos (regex on origin URL)
protectedRepoPattern.description: Repos whose PRs must not target a protected branch, as a regex matched against the origin remote; empty turns the PR-base hold off, .* covers every repo

protectedUsers.title: Accounts whose access must never be removed
protectedUsers.description: Comma-separated usernames; deluser, usermod -G without -a, passwd -l and similar naming one of them are refused, locally or over ssh; empty uses $USER

shipCommands.title: Commands that imply commit, push and PR
shipCommands.description: Comma-separated slash command names (without the slash) whose turn may commit, push, open and merge PRs without a question

settingsCommands.title: Commands that imply settings edits
settingsCommands.description: Comma-separated slash command names whose turn may edit .claude/settings*.json without a question
